text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk in the park with 
Mejiro Ardan, she suddenly stopped, her 
eyes glued to a woman gazing at the 
surface of the water.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...! Could that person be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. I never expected one in a place 
like this— but it looks so much like...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...There is no mistake. That person is 
the stage actor I used to watch as a 
child—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
She should still be active even now... I 
remember watching her on stage with wide, 
sparkling eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To think we would meet in a place like 
this... It feels strangely nostalgic, 
almost as if we've turned back the clock 
to our childhood.
choice_data_list:
Since we're here, why not try talking to 
them a bit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? B-But... it would be rude to bother 
them out of the blue like that. Especially 
when they're on their private time...
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Is it really... acceptable? Of course, I 
intend to show the utmost respect, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I shall put myself in the 
shoes of a child once more... and bring 
those memories back to life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan joyfully conversed with the 
stage actor, in an unusually playful mood. 
I watched over her fondly for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for waiting, Trainer. I had 
a wonderful time—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...? Is something the matter, Trainer? You 
have such a puzzled look on your face...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-!? Wh-Why? My body is moving on its 
own...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. What on earth was that just 
now...?
choice_data_list:
Is it because I'm feeling like I did when 
I was little?

I wonder if it's because I'm feeling like 
I did when I was little?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...? In the first place, I was 
never the kind of child who could express 
her feelings through wild movements.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, surely not... Could the backlash have 
suddenly surfaced just now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I was surprised as well. To think my body 
would move on its own like that..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“Still... while what happened earlier took 
me by surprise, bringing back distant 
memories really is a wonderful thing.”
choice_data_list: ...Get into the mindset of a child, okay?
...Get into the mindset of a child, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Back when my heart danced with 
excitement just watching the worlds unfold 
upon the stage—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Jeez, Trainer, please stop playing 
pranks on me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm already all grown up, and yet, after 
all this time, to act like such a child—
choice_data_list:
Wouldn't it be nice to let loose just like 
that?

You could also say it's because of who you 
are now that you can do it.

You could also say it's because of who you 
are now that you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm already all grown up, and yet, after 
all this time, to act like such a child—
choice_data_list:
Wouldn't it be nice to let loose just like 
that?

You could also say it's because of who you 
are now that you can do it.

You could also say it's because of who you 
are now that you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In terms of spreading your wings and 
unwinding... it certainly might be a good 
idea, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, if that's the case, it feels a 
bit wrong for just one person to push 
ahead."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... If you'll keep me company, 
Trainer, I'll take this chance to spread 
my wings and relax a bit too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Your skipping is quite good, 
Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the two of us spent a silly yet 
peaceful moment together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, that does make a fair point.
choice_data_list:
It's proof that you've grown and come out 
of your shell, so to speak.

It's proof that you've grown and come out 
of your shell, so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Thinking of it that way, even 
conducting myself like this might become 
something I can cherish—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...It's quite embarrassing after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment that revealed a surprising 
habit of Mejiro Ardan's that even she 
wasn't aware of—
